decision.rationale: The official UBC Soma Laboratory homepage provides a substantive description of steroid hormone research, named funding agencies and an invitation to collaborate using its mass spectrometry capability. Observed navigation distinguishes research and publications, lab-member profiles, news and work/collaboration opportunities.

rules.rationale: The observed Lab Members section presents the people in the laboratory, including its director, staff, trainees and alumni, rather than research outputs.
Work With Us and Collaborate with us invite participation and collaboration with the laboratory.
The homepage explicitly distinguishes laboratory News from research and publications.
The observed Research and Publications sections describe scientific work and its outputs.

fallback.rationale: The laboratory studies steroid hormones in nervous and immune systems; explicit people, announcement and opportunity sections override the scientific research fallback.
